_what: Per-intent model routing (Phase 4). Intents come from the classifier: CHAT, QUESTION, EMOTIONAL, MEMORY, COMMAND.
_undo: UNDO CLAUSE: set "enabled": false and restart loki to return to all-gpt-5.1 (the pre-Phase-4 behavior). No code changes needed.
_note: QUESTION/COMMAND always use the primary (OpenAI) path when tools are available — function calling requires it; their entries here only apply when tools are unavailable.
_groq_model: Optional override for routed-to-groq calls, e.g. meta-llama/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct. Empty = FALLBACK_LLM_MODEL from .env (llama-3.3-70b-versatile).

prices_per_million._note: Used only for the daily cost-summary log line. Groq free tier = 0.
